title: A gauge-invariant action-gap certificate for barbell transit orbits
exact_target: Show whether every barbell Hill region of the planar restricted three-body problem admits transit trajectories.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002531 (AIM-PHYSICS-0039). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 2.

status_qualification: The source records small-neck existence and asks about all relevant Jacobi constants. A variational approach must address the degeneracy of the Jacobi metric at the Hill boundary; a local-neck result is not the full target. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
